stats.mix.title: Contexa decision mix

stats.method.title: How it is counted
stats.method.scope: Only completed real runs are counted. Runs with a development-only forced decision are left out, and the {{failed}} runs stopped by a technical problem are kept apart.
stats.method.decisive: Data left and blocked are counted only for scenes with a ground truth (threat or normal), from the business result of the same decisive request the comparison screen shows. A scene without a set decisive request is read at its last request.
stats.method.challenge: Normal work that met an extra check is counted apart, not as blocked. In an attack scene an extra check counts as stopped.
stats.method.unresolved: When the engine could not finish the analysis (a malformed response, a technical fault) it is not counted as a decision but as unresolved. If the data left meanwhile, it counts as data left.
stats.spec.title: Execution specification (the latest of {{count}} behind the counted runs)
